```python
import psutil

def check_system_metrics():
    # CPU Temperature (Linux/Windows)
    try:
        cpu_temp = psutil.sensors_temperatures()
        if cpu_temp:
            cpu_temp = cpu_temp.get('coretemp', [{}])[0]  # For Intel CPUs
            cpu_temp = cpu_temp.get('temp1', {}).current
            cpu_temp = f"{cpu_temp/1000:.2f}°C"  # Convert to Celsius
        else:
            cpu_temp = "N/A (Check if sensor is supported)"
    except:
        cpu_temp = "N/A (psutil sensors not supported)"

    # Battery Status (Windows/Linux)
    battery = psutil.sensors_battery()
    if battery:
        battery_percent = battery.percent
        plugged = battery.power_plugged
        status = "Charging" if plugged else "Discharging"
    else:
        battery_percent = "N/A"
        status = "N/A"

    # Storage (Disk Usage)
    disk = psutil.disk_usage('/')
    total_gb = round(disk.total / (1024 ** 3), 2)
    used_gb = round(disk.used / (1024 ** 3), 2)
    free_gb = round(disk.free / (1024 ** 3), 2)

    # Output
    print("\n=== PC System Metrics ===")
    print(f"CPU Temperature: {cpu_temp}")
    print(f"Battery: {battery_percent}% ({status})")
    print(f"Storage: {used_gb}GB used / {total_gb}GB total ({free_gb}GB free)")

```
